question:
**Find the part of the sentence that contains an error: **

All that is needed for the bill to pass (1)/ are a simple majority (2)/ and a signature from the presiding officer (3)/ to certify the vote. (4)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The error lies in the subject-verb agreement of the sentence.
 
• The subject of the sentence is "**All that is needed for the bill to pass**," which is singular.
 
• The verb "**are**" in part 2 should instead be "**is**" to match the singular subject.
